scenes.line: When systems fail, every minute counts.
Orders stop. Customers can't pay. And someone has to find out why, fast.
Meet Mend AI. It reads the logs and the metrics, weighs the evidence, and finds the real cause.
It fixes it safely, and an independent check proves the system truly recovered.
On twelve failures it had never seen, Mend fixed ninety-six percent, without breaking anything else.
Mend. Agents that bring failing systems back. Proof, not promises.
